title: HitmanContracts
description: Professional hitman and bounty contracts plugin with Vault economy, polished GUI, and live target tracking.
body:
# HitmanContracts

HitmanContracts adds a clean bounty and hitman system to Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, and Purpur servers.

## Core Features
- polished GUI for browsing players, choosing rewards, and accepting contracts
- Vault economy integration for escrow and payout
- live hunter tracking with compass guidance, action bar updates, and a floating marker over the target
- persistent storage with automatic contract expiration and refunds
- short command set built for fast use in-game

## Commands
- `/hit`
- `/hit put <player> <amount>`
- `/hit take <id>`
- `/hit list`
- `/hit me`
- `/hit reload`

## Requirements
- Java 8 or newer
- Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, or Purpur server
- Vault plugin installed and enabled
- one Vault-compatible economy plugin installed and enabled

### Supported economy plugins
- EssentialsX Economy
- CMI Economy
- iConomy and other Vault-compatible providers

### Important
If Vault or an economy provider is missing, HitmanContracts will disable itself for safety.

## Notes
- built without NMS for broad compatibility
- designed around 1.8.8+ servers
